review_candidates.title: Electronics Engineer
review_candidates.description: Build the Future of Autonomous Systems SYOS designs and manufactures advanced uncrewed systems across air, land, sea, and subsurface domains. We combine intelligent engineering, AI-driven autonomy, and innovative design to create next-generation vehicles operating in some of the world's most challenging environments. About The Role We’re looking for a talented Electronics Engineer to join our expanding Electronics Components team in the UK. This is a hands-on electronic hardware design role focused on developing the electronic systems that power our autonomous vehicles. You’ll design and develop multi-layer printed circuit boards (PCBs), digital circuits and hardware interfaces used in areas such as camera modules, vision systems, power supplies and automation. Working across schematic capture, PCB layout, high-speed digital design, prototyping and hardware debugging, you’ll help turn complex engineering requirements into reliable, production-ready electronic solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with Software, Design and Manufacturing teams to ensure seamless integration and high-quality outcomes. The role is fully remote within the UK, offering the opportunity to contribute to innovative autonomous technology while working from your chosen UK-based location. Please note: Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. Key Responsibilities Schematic Capture and PCB Design: Develop electronic schematics and design multi-layer PCB layouts for camera modules, vision systems and other electronic hardware. High-Speed Digital Design: Design circuits incorporating high-speed differential signalling, including MIPI CSI-2 and LVDS, with a focus on signal integrity and reliable sensor interfaces. Mixed-Signal Electronics: Integrate digital control logic and analogue signal conditioning to support optimal electronic system performance. FPGA and Microcontroller Integration: Support digital control, image preprocessing and hardware integration using FPGAs and embedded microcontrollers. Communication Interfaces: Design and integrate hardware interfaces such as USB, Ethernet, I2C, SPI and UART for reliable data transmission and system communication. Prototyping, Testing and Debugging: Build and test hardware prototypes, perform fault-finding and signal integrity testing, and resolve issues involving EMI/EMC, thermal management and circuit performance. Documentation and Collaboration: Work with Software, Design and Manufacturing teams to develop technical documentation, test plans, assembly procedures and design-for-manufacture guidelines. What We’re Looking For A degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. At least three years of professional experience in electronic hardware design and development. Strong proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout software, such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Fusion or Eagle. Demonstrable experience designing multi-layer PCBs, ideally six layers or more, including controlled-impedance routing. A strong understanding of high-speed digital design, signal integrity, differential pairs, impedance matching and PCB layout techniques for interfaces operating at 100 MHz and above. A solid foundation in digital electronics, including digital logic design, timing analysis and digital signal processing. Hands-on experience implementing hardware communication interfaces such as MIPI CSI-2, USB, Ethernet, I2C, SPI or UART. Practical experience assembling electronic prototypes, using oscilloscopes and logic analysers, and bringing new hardware designs into operation. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex hardware issues and develop effective solutions. Excellent technical documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines. Desirable Experience Experience with VHDL or Verilog for image processing or high-speed I/O. Experience developing microcontroller firmware using C, C++ or Python to control electronic or camera hardware. Familiarity with ADCs, DACs, power supply design and noise reduction techniques. Experience with MIPI CSI-2, LVDS or other high-speed camera interfaces. Understanding of DFM/DFA principles, production-ready component selection and design cost optimisation. Experience developing automated test fixtures and hardware validation procedures. To be eligible for this role, you must be able to meet the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). This includes confirming your identity, legal right to work in the UK, recent employment history, and criminal record (unspent convictions only). Why Join SYOS? Our mission is to extend human capability, protect people, and deliver operational advantage through accessible, scalable, and intelligent autonomous technology. Join a team of engineers, builders, and innovators pushing boundaries and solving real-world challenges across robotics, aerospace, and autonomy. If you’re an Electronics engineer who enjoys designing, building and debugging sophisticated hardware, and you want to apply your skills to technology with real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1）负责舱驾一体平台中间件的设计、核心模块开发与持续迭代 2）基于SOME/IP、DDS等协议，设计并实现座舱域与智驾域之间高并发、低延迟、高可靠的跨域通信机制与数据路由策略。 3）针对多核SoC及MCU架构，负责进程/线程调度、内存池管理及零拷贝（Zero-Copy）共享内存机制的开发，确保高负载状态下的系统实时性与确定性； 4）配合底层系统，实现跨操作系统（Linux/QNX/Android）的进程间通信（IPC）、共享内存管理及算力/内存资源的动态分配与隔离。 5）负责中间件的性能剖析与调优，解决多域融合场景下的通信延迟、内存泄漏、系统卡顿等疑难问题，保障系统稳定运行。 6）制定中间件接口规范（IDL），开发配套的自动化代码生成工具、调试工具及测试框架，提升跨团队协同开发效率。 7）进行车云协同、AI Agent跨域调用、大模型上车等行业前沿预研，探索中间件在大模型推理、多模态交互等场景下的技术赋能。 岗位要求： 1）计算机、电子工程、自动化等相关专业硕士及以上学历，5年以上车载中间件或相似软件开发经验，有完整的舱驾一体/中央计算平台量产项目经验者优先。 2）精通C/C++，具备扎实的数据结构、算法及多线程/多进程编程功底；深入理解Linux/QNX/Android等至少一种车载操作系统的内核机制、驱动模型及IPC原理。 3）深刻理解SOA架构理念；熟练掌握SOME/IP、DDS、MQTT等车载通信协议的原理、QoS配置及性能调优；熟悉AUTOSAR CP/AP规范者优先。 4）熟悉Hypervisor（如QNX Hypervisor、ACRN等）或容器化技术，了解多OS共存环境下的安全隔离与资源共享机制。 5）熟练使用CMake、Bazel等构建工具，精通Git工作流；具备优秀的系统级性能分析能力，熟练使用perf、gprof、VTune等工具定位瓶颈。 【加分项】 1）有高通SA8155/8295/8775、英伟达Orin/Thor等主流高算力SoC平台的实际开发与量产经验。 2）熟悉ISO 26262功能安全标准，有中间件层面的安全机制（如E2E保护、看门狗、冗余管理）设计经验。 3）解ROS2、CyberRT、eCAL等开源中间件框架，或有相关代码贡献。 4）深入理解 LLM Agent 技术体系，熟练掌握 ReAct、Function Calling、Memory、Planning 等范式； 有Prompt 编写、复杂任务编排、多智能体协作或长程记忆系统构建等AI 辅助开发经验者优先

This role offers the opportunity to work on a sophisticated, high-performance market data platform that processes large volumes of real-time and historical financial information. You will play a key role in modernizing the client's existing infrastructure by transitioning from a legacy commercial market data platform to a modern architecture powered by kdb+, Apache Iceberg, gRPC, and Apache Arrow Flight . Working closely with experienced solution architects and international engineering teams, you will take ownership of the .NET integration layer, ensuring seamless communication between existing applications and newly developed backend services. This is an excellent opportunity for a senior developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, optimizing high-throughput applications, and contributing to enterprise-scale platform modernization. Key Responsibilities Backend Development & System Integration Design, develop, and maintain high-performance .NET client components using C# and modern .NET frameworks. Build and integrate .NET clients with backend services using gRPC, Protocol Buffers (Protobuf), and streaming communication . Modernize existing .NET application wrappers while preserving compatibility with established public interfaces. Replace legacy backend integrations with modern gRPC and Apache Arrow Flight services. Collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams to implement scalable, maintainable integration solutions. High-Performance Data Processing Develop efficient mechanisms for converting columnar data formats, including Apache Arrow record batches, into application-specific .NET data types. Optimize application performance when handling large volumes of financial and time-series data. Implement efficient memory management, asynchronous processing, and streaming techniques. Ensure data accuracy and precision, particularly when processing timestamps, time zones, and numerical values. Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance, serialization, and data integration issues. Platform Modernization & Quality Engineering Contribute to the migration of market data services from legacy systems to modern distributed architectures. Develop automated tests to validate data consistency between existing and newly implemented backend services. Support data reconciliation, integration testing, and application migration activities. Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain high standards of code quality, reliability, documentation, and software engineering best practices. Required Qualifications 6+ years of professional experience in software development, with strong expertise in C# and modern .NET (.NET 6 or later). Proven production experience developing and integrating gRPC services in .NET , including Grpc.Net.Client, Protocol Buffers, generated client code, and streaming RPC calls. Hands-on experience working with Apache Arrow in .NET or comparable columnar data formats . Strong understanding of high-performance backend development, distributed systems, and client-server architectures. Experience handling large-scale or high-volume datasets, with emphasis on application performance and memory efficiency. Proficiency in asynchronous programming, streaming, and memory optimization using technologies such as Span, Memory, and related .NET capabilities. Strong knowledge of data serialization, numeric precision, timestamp handling, and time zone management. Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and automated validation procedures. Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and collaborative software development workflows. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate directly with international engineering teams. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience with Apache Arrow Flight or Arrow Flight SQL . Familiarity with kdb+ , q programming, or .NET integration libraries such as csharpkdb and qSharp. Experience integrating or modernizing market data platforms such as OneTick, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, or similar systems. Previous experience working in financial services, investment banking, hedge funds, trading platforms, or financial technology. Knowledge of financial market data concepts, including trades, quotes, order books, market timestamps, and historical time-series data. Exposure to equities, options, futures, foreign exchange (FX), or fixed-income markets. Familiarity with Linux environments, containerization technologies such as Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Python-based backend services or modern data lake architectures, including Apache Iceberg. What Makes This Opportunity Exciting? High-Impact Engineering Project: Contribute to the modernization of a mission-critical market data platform supporting sophisticated financial operations. Modern Technology Stack: Gain exposure to high-performance technologies such as gRPC, Apache Arrow, kdb+, and Apache Iceberg. Technical Ownership: Take responsibility for the .NET integration layer and contribute directly to key architectural and engineering decisions. International Collaboration: Work alongside experienced architects and engineering professionals supporting a major hedge fund. Complex Engineering Challenges: Solve real-world problems involving high-volume data processing, distributed systems, performance optimization, and data integrity. Fully Remote Arrangement: Work from anywhere in the Philippines while collaborating with an international engineering team. Work Arrangement & Engagement Details Location: Philippines – Local Employment Only Work Setup: 100% Remote Schedule: Full-Time, Night Shift (US Eastern Time) Open Positions: 1 Recruitment Process Shortlisted candidates will undergo a technical interview focusing on C#/.NET development, gRPC, and high-performance data processing, including Apache Arrow or equivalent technologies. The assessment will also include a short live coding exercise. Candidates may be asked to discuss relevant projects, technical contributions, data processing challenges, and their experience developing production-grade .NET applications. Interested in taking your .NET expertise to the next level? If you are passionate about building high-performance applications, working with modern distributed technologies, and contributing to a major financial platform modernization initiative, we encourage you to apply. Join a technically challenging project where your engineering expertise will have a direct impact on the reliability, performance, and evolution of a sophisticated market data platform.
